description_en: Enables DAS Professional Edition for a specified instance
name: EnableDasPro

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID, which is the ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that created the database instance.

This parameter is optional. After you specify the ID of the target database instance, the system automatically obtains the instance ID when you call the API operation
parameters.help_zh:
用户ID，即创建数据库实例的阿里云主账号ID。

非必填，输入目标数据库实例ID后，在调用API接口时，系统会自动获取用户ID
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the database
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The storage duration of SQL Explorer data. Unit: days. Default value: 30. Valid values:

30
180
365
1095
1825
parameters.help_zh:
SQL洞察数据存储时长，单位为天，默认为30。

30
180
365

parameters.name: sql_retention

Message.description_en:
The message returned for the request.

If the request is successful, Successful is returned. If the request fails, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。

请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功。

false：执行失败
